name: Prismatic Ray (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School evocation; Level sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect one ray
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You must succeed on a ranged touch attack with the ray to affect the target. On a successful attack, a creature of 6 HD or fewer is blinded for 2d4 rounds. Additionally, the creature hit by the ray (regardless of HD) suffers a randomly determined effect per the table below:
